$comment: Benchmark settings. Model IDs and prices were checked against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models on 2026-11-16; run `pnpm bench:models` to check them again. Prices are USD per million tokens.

models.label: Claude Opus 5.5
models.why: OpenRouter describes it as Anthropic's flagship model; Claude Fable 5.2 is listed as more capable but costs twice as much.

models.label: GPT-6 Astra
models.why: OpenRouter describes it as OpenAI's flagship; GPT-6.1 Sol is newer but is positioned below it.

models.label: Gemini 4 Argon
models.why: OpenRouter describes it as Google's flagship reasoning model.

models.label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
models.why: OpenRouter describes it as Moonshot AI's flagship open-weight model, and its weights are on Hugging Face (moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro).

$reasoning: OpenRouter's reasoning parameter (https://openrouter.ai/docs/use-cases/reasoning-tokens), sent the same to both formats. null sends nothing, so each model reasons as it does by default. Otherwise { "effort": "high" } (max, xhigh, high, medium, low, minimal, none) or { "maxTokens": 8000 }, not both. Reasoning counts against maxTokens and is billed as output.
$reserveMargin: Before each call the run reserves that call's worst case (all maxTokens, at the listed prices) times this factor, or times the highest billed-to-listed price ratio seen for the model if that is larger. In the first real run one provider billed up to 1.23 times the listed price.

estimate.$comment: Assumptions used only for the cost estimate printed before a run, when no earlier run is given with --estimate-from. Output tokens include hidden reasoning tokens, which these models bill as output. 10000 is the mean of the first tries in the first real run (pilot-1: 9,762; medians by model and format 6,645 to 16,000).
